status.description: done: the whole task is complete and verified as far as possible. partial: some of it is done, the rest is described in notes_for_reviewer. blocked: could not proceed; the reason is in blocked_on.

summary.description: Two to five sentences: what was done and how it was verified.

changes.description: Every file touched, one entry per file.

path.description: Path relative to the worktree root.

note.description: One line: what changed in this file and why.

verification.description: Commands run to verify the work (tests, linters, builds) and their outcome.

note.description: Key output, failure reason, or why it was not run.

assumptions.description: Decisions made where the task was ambiguous.

blocked_on.description: What prevented completion (missing dependency, network, unclear requirement). Empty string when nothing blocked.

notes_for_reviewer.description: What the reviewer should look at first, known gaps, follow-ups. Empty string when none.
